taiwan_strait_2026.name: Taiwan Strait, 2026
taiwan_strait_2026.description: China escalates military pressure on Taiwan. The US must navigate between deterrence and conflict. Meanwhile, Russia probes NATO's eastern flank, and India watches from the sidelines.

crises.name: Taiwan Strait Military Escalation
crises.description: PLA naval exercises have moved from scheduled to continuous. Taiwan's air identification zone has been violated 14 times this month.

crises.name: US-China Trade War
crises.description: Semiconductor export controls have expanded to include EUV equipment and advanced packaging. China's retaliatory rare earth restrictions are hitting US defense production.

crises.name: Baltic Infrastructure Probe
crises.description: Coordinated probes on Estonian, Latvian, and Lithuanian power grid SCADA systems. Attribution is 70% confident to GRU Unit 74455.
